mentions.name: Active recall studying app
mentions.description: This study app helps users practice active recall: it first hides user-provided content and asks them to remember as much as they can before reading, then reveals the material paragraph by paragraph, and finally prompts the user to actively recall what they learned and compare it to what they knew at the start.
mentions.source_excerpt: - Active recall studying app that allows a user to practice active recall[0]. The app hides user provided content at first and asking the user to try to remember all they can before reading the content. Then the user goes through the material slowly revealing each paragraph from their input. At the end they try to actively remember what they learned and can even compare to what they knew at the start.
